title: Meaning gives expectations proportion

captions.physics: Discussing hope of understanding words better
captions.energy: Sharing a considered understanding of replies

meaning: You can discuss hope of understanding words better and share a considered understanding of your replies, feeling proportion between expectations without assigning one universally correct meaning.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Star in the physical position appears in hoping to understand each other’s words better. The Hermit in energy supports a wish to consider your own answer and share the understanding gained. Justice in emotions brings a sense of proportion between different expectations. You can want greater clarity while distinguishing personal meaning from a promise for both. A considered explanation assigns no single meaning to a word for every future exchange.

Suppose you say, “One day we will understand why we hear ‘later’ so differently”. In a particular conversation, one answer meant “after this task”, while the other heard indefinite postponement. **Explaining meaning helps give expectations proportion**. You can describe what lay behind your own words and hear another reading. There is a fair sense of measure: intention is not lost, but the other expectation is not dismissed as imaginary either. The earlier ambiguity still belongs to the conversation’s history; explaining it does not make it disappear retrospectively.

Difficulty arises if the explanation becomes a permanent dictionary both must now follow. Personal understanding overrides new circumstances and actual responses. Constructive Hermit energy helps share considered meaning without presenting it as the final explanation. You can rely on today’s meaning and clarify a familiar word again; proportion remains when an earlier account helps listening rather than deciding in advance what each person should have heard.
